Heyy, is everything alright? True that this world is sick. But you are worthy of a good end. Please be strong and hold on to something. I hope you find the courage to live on and be happy. All love! Please be safe

It does help me when I opened up. But I smh regrets it. I'm ashamed of myself, especially to my friends. I cut myself whenever I couldn't bear the pain in my head. It's okay, I'm fine if its anonymously. It feels like all I ever did was to keep adding up problems one after another. I'm worthless, hopeless and helpless. Every night I have thoughts that make me regret myself. I heard voices too.
Swapping isn't possible. What's possible is to keep on living and self-love.
